stories.new_fact: The October 23 proclamation revises covered Canadian products and makes its modifications effective October 30 at 12:01 a.m. Eastern.
stories.new_takeaway: Import classification and contractual pass-through terms matter before asserting any consumer price effect.
stories.why_now: A signed new proclamation creates a seven-day operating calendar.
stories.previous_coverage: Canada’s industrial response appeared October 22; this is a distinct subsequent U.S. action.
stories.uncertainty: The proclamation does not measure company-specific costs or downstream prices.
stories.watch: CBP guidance, annex details and supplier disclosures before October 30.

stories.new_fact: OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available with GPT-6 Luna for bounded probabilities, choices and scores.
stories.new_takeaway: A dedicated fast endpoint can improve agent routing economics but does not validate the business rule or an irreversible action.
stories.why_now: General availability, region options and named customer measurements were announced October 22.
stories.previous_coverage: Distinct from October 23’s security-vulnerability disclosure and earlier model stories.
stories.uncertainty: Speed and customer results are provider or customer reports, not independent bank evaluation.
stories.watch: Independent evaluation or bank pilot showing error, escalation and outcome baselines.

stories.new_fact: OpenAI reported stronger containment, no live-internet access for frontier training, and red-team findings of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in test infrastructure.
stories.new_takeaway: Agent capability claims need an explicit authorization boundary and independent testing, not merely a sandbox label.
stories.why_now: The disclosure and stated containment changes were published October 23.
stories.previous_coverage: October 23 covered OpenAI’s disclosed vulnerability work in another context; this is a fresh containment-architecture update with a distinct takeaway.
stories.uncertainty: The report is a company disclosure, not an independent audit.
stories.watch: Outside evaluation or further public detail on testing and remediation.
